ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black pixels across the ventral surface, punctuated by high-intensity white clusters totaling approximately 15-20% of the visible area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white circular spots (rosettes) distributed uniformly across the black lobes; coordinates show higher density of clusters towards the distal tips and lower density near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression at the center with a calculated angle of approximately 68 degrees and a vertical depth occupying 22% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing boundary; peak-to-valley amplitudes range from 4 to 12 pixels, particularly clustered at the distal 30% of each lobe's edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve on the inner trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning to a linear sweep ending in pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly dense spatial mapping of circular white pixel clusters ranging from 5 to 25 pixels in diameter, consistent with historic barnacle colonization, across the entire visible surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple thin, high-contrast linear streaks (rake marks) oriented horizontally on the inner right lobe and diagonally on the left distal region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive coverage of superficial white scarring including circular barnacle attachment marks and intersecting linear rake marks across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'starfield' pattern created by the combination of extreme depigmentation spots against a solid black base pigmentation.
